palette.note: Original fill RGB values only; native FC geometry rendering and patterns are retained.

rendering: Verified global-route centerlines and polygons of the named interface nets over the calibrated native FC layout. Highlight widths aid visibility; path coordinates are read from saved global_route shapes.
limitations: Region outlines describe backend constraints, not separate hard macros or fences for every later physical cell.
Timing and DRC closure require independent reports; the picture does not establish signoff readiness.

stage_evidence.selector: Up to one verified net per interface mask, up to three per CGRA, Gemmini and Pool port group. Leaf pins span at least two region owners and 120 µm Manhattan distance. Highlights use explicit saved global_route point lists, or native FC routing with positive routed length verified using GRoute visibility controls.
